description.value: The Peri Peri Shack is a flame-grilled chicken restaurant in New Westminster specializing in Portuguese-African peri peri cuisine, offering whole and half chickens marinated for 24 hours in a house spice blend across seven heat profiles from Plain to Peri Nero. The menu also covers seafood skewers, sharing packs, rice bowls, and a range of sides, with catering available for groups. It grew from a single location into a multi-location brand with franchising on offer, positioning itself as a community gathering spot.
